label: Решить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for решить (to decide, to solve).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. Решить is perfective, so 'решу' is its simple future. Note the стем shift ш in решу, решишь, against the infinitive реш-.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Решишь' shows the -ишь ending. As a perfective, it points to one final decision rather than a process.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Решит' carries the -ит ending and means a single completed resolving. The imperfective partner is решать.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Решим' uses the -им ending; the perfective frames a single finished decision.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Решат' closes the person set with the -ат ending. Perfective решить contrasts with iterative решать.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Решил' is the completed -л past of решить. It governs an infinitive 'уехать', a very common decision pattern.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Решила' adds the feminine -ла ending. Here решить means to solve a problem, its second core sense.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Решили' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders. 'Наконец' stresses the finality of the perfective.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Реши' is the informal command of решить. The perfective fits a single, decisive choice.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. After 'нужно', решить stays in the infinitive. The perfective infinitive stresses bringing the matter to a close today.
